usedFor: DocuSeal tracks templates, forms and signatures, and Calendly gets a booking link from “Create Scheduling Link” once something happens there.

bestTemplate.name: “Submission Completed” in DocuSeal, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A finished submission is a natural point to offer the next meeting, and the action produces the booking link.

watchOut: “New Template” polls on a schedule while “Template Created” is pushed, so pick the second to avoid delay.
